newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU calls on Serbs to allow parliament dissolution.
newsitem.headline: EU calls on Serbs to allow parliament dissolution.

text.p: The European Union called on Bosnian Serbs on Friday not to block the dissolution of parliament in Pale and to abide by the Dayton peace agreement.
In a statement, the Luxembourg EU presidency said that the decision by Bosnian Serb President Biljana Plavsic to dissolve parliament "conforms with the constitution of the Srpska Republic".
It called on all parties to respect the constitution and to avoid action that threatened peace.
Plavsic defied hardliners trying to force her from power on Thursday and ordered the dissolution of the Bosnian Serb parliament "to protect the state from total disaster".
The government said it would block her decision.
